cards.preview: Trump backs Ramaswamy’s attack on Amy Acton as Ohio’s Republican governor condemns it. The roundup also tracks Musk’s record campaign spending and warns that strong Democratic polls may overstate the party’s advantage.

cards.title: The agony of liberal Europe
cards.preview: Europe’s protests reflect frustration with living costs, weak growth and struggling public services, while debt limits governments’ room to respond. The issue argues that this squeeze is weakening the political centre and helping populists whose promises may be unaffordable.
